extracted.name: Spinach with chickpeas, pine nuts & raisins
extracted.description: Enjoy this simple spinach side dish with Spanish-style chicken dishes. Toasted almonds work well, too
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp olive oil plus a drizzle
instruction_lines: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan. Add the shallot and garlic, and cook until softened. Add the spices, chickpeas and raisins, and cook for 2 mins.
Tip in the spinach and cook until just wilted. Stir in the pine nuts and serve with an extra drizzle of oil.
